_about: Public-domain Thomas Neely Ralston (1806-1891), Kentucky Methodist theologian, for the Word Hoard: Elements of Divinity (Louisville, 1851), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 52 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ralston-elements-of-divinity: Elements of divinity: or, A course of lectures, comprising ... the system of theology as taught in the Holy Scriptures (Louisville, Ky., E. Stevenson, 1851)

_excluded.ralston-other: The 1924 revised Elements of Divinity (published 1924 but revised by others; left out); the Danish translation (1858). W. R. S. Ralston's Russian tales are the separate ralston shelf
